title:
Option-Implied Probability That the S&P 500
Will Be Down in December 2027
units: Decline from the November 13, 2026 close to December 17, 2027
source: Cboe delayed quotes; S&P Dow Jones Indices; author’s calculations.
note: Options: risk-neutral probabilities that the index is at or below each level when options expiring December 17, 2027 settle, from put prices across strikes (bid-ask midpoints at the November 13 close, a 4 percent interest rate) — where the index ends up that day, not a fall at any point before it. History: share of days since 1946 on which the S&P 500 was that far down 13 months later.
columns: How often it has happened since 1946
